summary: BAR1 and BAR2 address-space setup: initialises both BAR regions by writing base addresses to MMIO 0x1704 (BAR1) and 0x1714 (BAR2), manages VMM partitions for each region, and flushes pending BAR writes via MMIO 0x070000.

dtor.what: Deallocates VMM partitions and instance memory references for BAR0 and BAR1 regions

oneinit.what: Initialises BAR2 address space then calls bar2.init and sets up BAR1 with lock classification

bar1.init.what: Writes BAR1 instance base address shifted by 12 bits into MMIO 0x1704 with bit 31 set

bar1.fini.what: Clears bit 31 in MMIO 0x1704 to disable BAR1 address space mapping

bar1.wait.what: Calls bar flush twice to wait for pending BAR write operations to complete

bar1.vmm.what: Returns the VMM pointer for BAR1 address space region from the bar structure

bar2.init.what: Writes BAR0 instance base address shifted by 12 bits into MMIO 0x1714 with bit 31 set

bar2.fini.what: Clears bit 31 in MMIO 0x1714 to disable BAR2 address space mapping

bar2.wait.what: Calls bar flush twice to wait for pending BAR write operations to complete

bar2.vmm.what: Returns the VMM pointer for BAR0 address space region from the bar structure

flush.what: Sets MMIO 0x070000 bit 0 then waits up to 2ms for bit 1 to confirm flush completed
